notes.subject: הבן יקיר לי
notes.rationale: Qere/KJV rebit long askim ('Aisa Efraim...?'), tasol KJV raun long Hebrew i tok statement: 'pikinini bilong delait bilong mi'.

notes.subject: marimari tru
notes.rationale: רחם em i klosu long 'fondle / pulim narapela klostu' — 'marimari' i holim hap tasol.

notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: מעי em i bel insait (intestines) — ples bilong pilosopi long Tok Pisin em i bel.

notes.subject: דברי בו
notes.rationale: 'mi tok long em' — KJV 'against him' (tok skru tumas), JPS 'of him' (tok wantaim).

notes.subject: זכר אזכרנו / רחם ארחמנו
notes.rationale: Infinitive-absolute + verb initpass namel — 'tingting mi tingting strong, marimari mi gat marimari tru' — infitive-absolute i no gat long Tok Pisin.

translation: Apinun, Efraim em i pikinini bilong delait bilong mi, o no? Em i pikinini bilong pilai wantaim mi? Long wanem, oltaim mi tok long em, mi tingting strong long em yet; olsem na, bel bilong mi i karai krai long em, mi gat marimari tru long em — Yahwe i tok.
